notes.title: Lost Dreams – Revamped Game
notes.content: [p]The game has been completely revamped and is now focused on horror.[/p][p]Same story but told differently, new graphics, new system.[/p][p]We are aware of the issues with the base game. Thanks to everyone who took the time to give us feedback, the game has been completely reborn.[/p][p]The changes are very deep, we would love for those who abandoned the game to give it a new chance ♥, and if you haven’t played it yet, now is the time.[/p][p]Here is the new content:[/p][p]Frank will have different types of weapons at his disposal to survive on the island, from a knife, pistol, shotgun, crossbow, to an assault rifle.[/p][p]Some weapons can be obtained during the story, while others can be purchased in stores scattered throughout the game.[/p][p]You can now save your progress on old computers distributed across the island. A floppy disk is required to use them and save your progress.[/p][p]You will have 8 inventory slots, so you will need to manage your space, items, and weapons carefully.[/p][p]In several parts of the environments, there will be an object chest where you can store items you don’t want to use at the moment. You can later retrieve them from any chest, which is crucial for resource management.[/p][p]Chests have been replaced with barrels that you can break to obtain the items inside, so stay alert when you see them to collect supplies.[/p][p]Exploration is crucial for survival, as exploring will provide ammunition, healing items, and any important items that may facilitate your adventure.[/p][p]Enemies can now trap you and try to bite you. You will have to get rid of them to avoid as much damage as possible.[/p][p]You can see your health status in the inventory. You can heal and restore health by using injectable syringes scattered across the environment.[/p][p]As always, solving puzzles to progress in the story is present.[/p][p]We have fixed localization issues in the inventory and items, so everything is now correctly translated.[/p]

notes.title: Many improvements are coming to Capibara Lost Dreams
notes.content: [p]We are aware of the current issues with [b]Capibara Lost Dreams[/b], which is why we’ve been working for some time on a series of improvements that will completely change the gameplay experience. These changes are major, and we’re excited to show you what’s coming ♥[/p][p][b]What will the new version include?[/b][/p][list][*][p]A completely revamped gameplay system[/p][/*][*][p]New cutscenes[/p][/*][*][p]Different parts of the story[/p][/*][*][p]Full graphical overhaul — environments are being entirely remade[/p][/*][*][p]It will be more like a “Remake”[/p][/*][/list][p]As the release date approaches, we’ll share a preview ♥[/p]

notes.title: Big Update! The game has been revamped
notes.content:
Playing Capibara Lost Dreams will now be much smoother and fun! Numerous changes have been implemented to enhance gameplay. List of changes:

Added Latin Spanish Dubbing. (You can select it from within the game)

Added Japanese Dubbing. (You can select it from within the game)

Players can now level up by defeating enemies and gaining experience.

Various enemy types have been added, some stronger than others; defeating them helps you level up.

Hearts have been replaced with a health bar that players can improve by leveling up.

Players now have a Stamina bar used for attacks, running, dodging, and shielding.

A Strength bar has been added for increasing damage.

Campfires have been added for resting, saving the game, and setting respawn points. Experience points earned from defeating enemies can also be allocated there.

Weapons now have different damage values.

The inventory has been completely revamped.

Several tutorials have been added for new features.

Sprinting is now possible.

An issue where dodging did not avoid damage has been fixed.

An issue allowing infinite wall jumping has been corrected.

Stealth zones have been added where players can hide in bushes to avoid detection.

Instant takedowns are now possible by attacking enemies from behind.

Enemies now patrol areas.

Vendors have been added.

Animations have been smoothed out overall.

The character can now perform heavy attacks that consume more stamina.

A bow and arrows have been added.

The character can slide on the ground for faster movement.

Wooden crates now drop items when broken.

The character can heal using potions, which can be replenished at campfires.

An optional activity has been added where players must find a lost Capibara item; finding it rewards significant bonuses.

The game has been divided into 19 chapters, with notifications when starting a new chapter.
